data.title: Founder dinner
data.transcript: Speaker 1: Strictly confidential: we're in acquisition talks with a much bigger company, and the term sheet values us at forty million. Nobody outside the board knows. I'm Joaquim Reyes, by the way, founder of Brightwater Robotics. Speaker 2: Understood, that stays with me. Speaker 1: Do you know a good M and A lawyer? Speaker 2: I can introduce you to Hedda Nyquist, she handled a deal like this. I'll send the introduction tomorrow. Speaker 1: And send me the deck from your talk, too. Speaker 2: Will do.
